title: DevContext AI Architecture Node Graph
description: Structured output contract for the DECOMPOSE component. Deliberately shallow: a quantized on-device SLM must be able to satisfy this reliably. Enrichment fields (candidates, rationale) are added downstream by SCOUT and COMPILE, never by the model. Validated against JSON Schema draft-07 (pinned in devcontext/models.py).

project_name.description: Short human-readable project name inferred from the request.

summary.description: One or two sentences restating what is being built.

constraints.description: Non-functional constraints stated or clearly implied by the request (offline support, low bandwidth, privacy, realtime).

nodes.description: The architectural requirement nodes rendered on the Flutter canvas.

id.description: snake_case stable identifier, unique within the graph.

title.description: Display label for the canvas node.

requirement.description: What this part of the system must do, in plain language. Becomes the SCOUT query seed and the embedded text in semantic_cache.db.

search_hint.description: Optional extra keywords to sharpen the semantic search for this node.
